hero.name: Leon Latsch
hero.intro: Hi! My name is up there and I'm a Software Developer living in Hamburg. Here you can find a summary of my private projects.
hero.sideNote: Open source, self-hosting, smart home hardware.

esp32.title: ESP32 Intercom Extension
esp32.description: A ESP32 based PCB designed to control a Siedle HT611-01 intercom system. It allows features like remote door opening, doorbell notification, and muting.

photok.title: Photok: Foto Tresor
photok.description: Photok is a open source photo safe app. All data is encrypted locally on the device which stores them securely.

kolibriSuite.title: Kolibri Messenger (App + Server)
kolibriSuite.description: Kolibri is a private Android messenger and its self-hosted server backend.

godaddy.title: GoDaddy DynDNS
godaddy.description: Python based GoDaddy DynDNS script using only the GoDaddy API.

scrypt.title: SCrypt
scrypt.description: SCrypt is a JavaFX Desktop Application to encrypt and decrypt files with AES-256.

scryptLite.title: SCrypt lite
scryptLite.description: SCrypt lite is the terminal equivalent to SCrypt. It encrypts and decrypts files with AES-256.

pc2mqtt.title: pc2mqtt
pc2mqtt.description: Control your PC or homeserver via MQTT (e.g. Home Assistant). Exposes power sensor, shutdown button, and reboot button.

goResolve.title: go-resolve
goResolve.description: DynDNS without DynDNS. A rewrite of godaddy-dyndns in Go.

esp32.title: ESP32 Intercom Extension
esp32.text: An ESP32-based PCB extension for a Siedle HT611-01 intercom system. It supports remote door opening, doorbell notifications, and muting, plus setup documentation for assembly, flashing, and installation.

photok.title: Photok: Foto Tresor
photok.text: Photok is a privacy-first photo vault for Android. Your photos stay encrypted on-device and protected by your password. You can install it via Google Play or F-Droid.

kolibriSuite.title: Kolibri Messenger (App + Server)
kolibriSuite.text: Kolibri consists of a private Android messenger and its self-hosted server backend. The app and server are fully open source and designed for privacy-focused communication.

godaddy.title: GoDaddy DynDNS
godaddy.text: A lightweight Python DynDNS updater for GoDaddy DNS records, using only the official GoDaddy API.

scrypt.title: SCrypt
scrypt.text: A JavaFX desktop application for AES-256 file encryption and decryption, distributed with releases for easy local usage.

scryptLite.title: SCrypt lite
scryptLite.text: The terminal version of SCrypt for AES-256 file encryption and decryption, focused on scripting and automation workflows.

pc2mqtt.title: pc2mqtt
pc2mqtt.text: pc2mqtt runs on your PC or homeserver and exposes state/actions over MQTT for automation systems like Home Assistant. It provides a power sensor plus shutdown and reboot buttons. Setup differs by OS: Linux uses a binary + systemd service, Windows uses WinSW as a service wrapper.

goResolve.title: go-resolve
goResolve.text: DynDNS without DynDNS: a Go rewrite of godaddy-dyndns.

about.headline: Mobile Apps and Smart Home. Open source first.
about.text: I build native mobile apps, self-hosted smart home tools, and the occasional piece of custom hardware. I’m also interested in open source and well-designed software.

contact.headline: Let’s build something useful.
contact.note: The best way to reach me is email. For code and releases, use GitHub.
